notes: F-TYP-018 (TYP-12.2): no size_of intrinsic exists in Core 1.0, so any use is a resolution failure. The original source used `size_of::<i32>()`, which DIAG-1.4 makes unreachable: the turbofish is a parse error (F-UNS-019), and an early phase prevents later phases on the same node, so the expected resolution code could never be produced. The source now uses the reachable form; the expected code and the requirement are unchanged.
